aiHeadlines: 📊 Barcelona top La Liga on 16 points after 6 rounds.
🧱 Nobody is harder to score on than Barcelona: 1 conceded all season.
⚽ Barcelona have the sharpest attack in La Liga: 14 scored in 4 rounds.
📊 Real Madrid top La Liga on 9 points after 3 rounds.
⏰ Deadline day is done. The window is shut until January.
⏳ Deadline week. Any business left undone stays undone until the next window.
🛡️ Torvald Merrion has gone to Espanyol unanswered. Real Madrid need a new defence coach.
🛡️ Espanyol have come in for Torvald Merrion, your defence coach. Match their offer on the Staff desk within 2 weeks or he goes. You can match 2 more offers this season.

boardObjectives.label: Win the La Liga and Copa del Rey double
Have 8 players from Spain in the squad
Have 5 players aged 30 or over in the squad

inbox.text: International break: the window runs 21 Sep to 6 Oct, and the calendar here keeps your fixtures going through it, so they went straight after your last game. Away with their countries (France: Kylian Mbappé, Aurélien Tchouaméni, Eduardo Camavinga and Ibrahima Konaté; Brazil: Vinicius Junior, Rodrygo and Endrick; England: Jude Bellingham and Trent Alexander-Arnold; Uruguay: Federico Valverde; Türkiye: Arda Güler; Cote d'Ivoire: Yan Diomande; Spain: Dean Huijsen, Álvaro Carreras and Marc Cucurella; Morocco: Brahim Díaz; Portugal: Bernardo Silva; Netherlands: Denzel Dumfries; Ukraine: Andriy Lunin). They are back for the Athletic Club game. Kylian Mbappé, Vinicius Junior, Jude Bellingham, Federico Valverde, Arda Güler, Aurélien Tchouaméni, Yan Diomande, Álvaro Carreras, Rodrygo, Bernardo Silva and Andriy Lunin started for their countries, the rest mostly watched from the bench. The long trips hurt most. Your assistant wants to know: start them against Athletic Club, or rest the spent ones for that one game?

options.label: Rest the ones who are spent

inbox.text: Trent Alexander-Arnold pulled you aside after training. The short version: he wants to start on Saturday.

An agent has been in touch about Federico Valverde, who is 27 and has a year left. The desk prices a new deal at £22.7m up front on 126k a week for 4 years. Say nothing and he can talk to anyone in the summer.
Aurélien Tchouaméni pulled you aside after training. The short version: he wants to start on Saturday.

pending.text: Eduardo Camavinga has started 0 of the last 5. Is he finished at this club?

options.label: He is still my player
options.line: You backed him in front of everybody. He will run through a wall on Saturday.

options.label: He has to earn it back
options.line: Standards, in public. Ten of them heard it as a warning and one heard it as a demotion.

options.label: You would have to ask him
options.line: A shrug and a next question. He was not wounded by it and nobody else was impressed either.

decisions.text: The board have £200k spare this quarter and want to know where you want it. They will put it in the transfer pot if you ask, and they would read holding it back as a careful manager.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
